I do not have money to buy chemical fertilizer for this small plot, and my beans grow well enough with the manure I collect from our animals. I keep my own seeds from last season because they are reliable and I know how they grow here. The rains will come as God wills, so I do not irrigate. My children and I will work this plot ourselves as we always have.
